title: After-School Tutoring
shortDescription: Providing personalized academic support to help students master core subjects and build confidence in their abilities.
overview: Our After-School Tutoring program gives students a structured learning environment beyond regular school hours, with focused support in reading, writing, mathematics, and classroom readiness.
The program is designed to meet each learner at their current level and build steady progress through repetition, encouragement, and guided practice.
We work closely with families so that students receive consistent academic support, improved routines, and stronger confidence in school participation.
highlights: Personalized support in core academic subjects
Confidence-building through regular practice and feedback
Homework support and reinforcement of school learning
outcomes: Better foundational reading and numeracy skills
Higher confidence in completing school tasks independently
Stronger communication between educators and families

title: Scholarship Fund
shortDescription: Expanding access to learning by supporting students with essential educational resources, fee assistance, and continuity in their studies.
overview: The Scholarship Fund helps children and young adults continue their education by reducing the financial barriers that often interrupt learning journeys.
This support can include fee assistance, educational materials, uniforms, transport help, and other essentials that make consistent school participation possible.
The program is built to protect educational continuity and ensure that promising learners are not left behind because of economic hardship.
highlights: Fee and resource support for eligible students
Assistance with books, uniforms, and learning materials
Encouragement for continued attendance and retention
Focused support for families facing financial pressure
outcomes: Reduced dropout risk among vulnerable learners
Greater family confidence in long-term schooling
More equitable access to learning opportunities

title: Digital Literacy
shortDescription: Equipping learners with practical digital skills so they can engage confidently with technology, communication tools, and modern learning methods.
overview: Our Digital Literacy program introduces learners to essential technology skills in a practical and supportive setting.
Students learn how to use digital devices, basic software tools, and communication platforms in ways that are relevant to education, independence, and future readiness.
The program focuses on confidence, safe technology use, and hands-on learning so participants can use digital tools meaningfully in everyday life.
highlights: Introduction to computers and digital devices
Basic typing, file handling, and educational software use
Safe and guided use of online tools and communication platforms
Practical digital skills linked to study and daily life
outcomes: Better readiness for modern education and work environments
Increased independence in digital communication and tasks
Stronger participation in practical and skill-based learning
